words.enDefinition: The iterative process of defining a need, developing alternatives, and checking a proposed solution.

examples.en: The engineering design process started with a classroom problem about organizing tools on a shared desk.
examples.zh: 这次「工程设计过程」从一道课堂题开始，目标是整理共用桌上的工具。

examples.en: Our tutor used the engineering design process to explain why the team revisited its first sketch.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用「工程设计过程」说明小组为何重新审视第一张草图。

collocations: a stage of the engineering design process

words.enDefinition: A short description of what a user needs to accomplish or experience.

examples.en: The user need statement said students wanted to identify the storage slots quickly without moving the tray.
examples.zh: 「用户需求陈述」指出，学生希望不移动托盘就能快速辨认各储物格。

examples.en: We revised the user need statement after hearing how classmates actually used the sample desk organizer.
examples.zh: 听过同学们实际如何使用桌面收纳样品后，我们修改了「用户需求陈述」。

collocations: link a requirement to a user need statement

words.enDefinition: A clear, verifiable condition that an engineered item or system must satisfy.

examples.en: We stated an engineering requirement for the organizer to fit inside the drawer in our assignment.
examples.zh: 我们为作业中的收纳盒写下了一项「工程要求」，它必须放得进抽屉。

examples.en: Each engineering requirement in our table had a matching check in the classroom demonstration plan.
examples.zh: 课堂演示计划中的检查项逐一对应表中的各项「工程要求」。

words.enDefinition: A basis for judging or comparing possible design solutions.

examples.en: Ease of cleaning became a design criterion when we compared the sample trays during the workshop.
examples.zh: 在研讨课上比较样品托盘时，是否容易清洁成了一项「设计评判准则」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to explain why each design criterion mattered for the proposed classroom organizer.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我们解释，为什么每项「设计评判准则」都与拟议的课堂收纳盒有关。

collocations: compare alternatives against a design criterion
assign weight to a design criterion

words.enDefinition: A condition specifying how well a product or system must perform a function.

examples.en: The worksheet expressed the performance requirement in terms of how many cards the model could hold.
examples.zh: 习题用模型能容纳的卡片数量来表述这项「性能要求」。

examples.en: We matched each performance requirement to a measurement the class could make on the small prototype.
examples.zh: 我们给各项「性能要求」都配上了一项可在小型原型上完成的课堂测量。

words.enDefinition: A requirement governing how two components connect, fit together, or exchange information.

examples.en: The interface requirement described how the two cardboard modules were supposed to line up in the model.
examples.zh: 「接口要求」说明了模型中的两个纸板模块应如何对齐。

examples.en: We found an interface requirement that applied to both halves of the classroom organizer.
examples.zh: 我们找到一项同时适用于课堂收纳盒两部分的「接口要求」。

words.enDefinition: A documented set of required design characteristics, dimensions, or performance levels.

examples.en: Our design specification gave the outer dimensions, material choice and intended capacity of the classroom model.
examples.zh: 「设计规格」列出了课堂模型的外形尺寸、所选材料和预期容量。

examples.en: We compared the prototype drawing with the design specification before measuring the model itself.
examples.zh: 测量模型之前，我们先将原型图和「设计规格」作了对照。

collocations: check a design against the design specification

words.enDefinition: A variable chosen or adjusted when defining a design, such as a dimension or material property.

examples.en: The distance between dividers was a design parameter in our adjustable model of the card tray.
examples.zh: 隔板间距是可调卡片托盘模型的一项「设计参数」。

examples.en: We changed one design parameter at a time while comparing computer models of the same tray.
examples.zh: 我们比较同一托盘的几个计算机模型，每次只改一个「设计参数」。

words.enDefinition: An outcome a design is intended to achieve or improve.

examples.en: The main design objective was to make the labels easier for students to see from above.
examples.zh: 主要「设计目标」是让学生从上方更容易看清标签。

examples.en: We discussed a second design objective after comparing how much space the two cardboard prototypes occupied.
examples.zh: 比较两个纸板原型的占用空间后，我们讨论了第二个「设计目标」。

words.enDefinition: The ability to follow links between requirements, their sources, and the evidence that addresses them.

examples.en: Our worksheet showed requirement traceability by linking each classroom model feature to the need behind it.
examples.zh: 我们的习题把课堂模型的各项特征与相应需求关联起来，展示了「需求可追踪性」。

examples.en: The tutor checked requirement traceability by following a numbered requirement through to its supporting test result.
examples.zh: 辅导老师从一项编号要求追踪到相应的试验结果，以检查「需求可追踪性」。

words.enDefinition: A table linking individual requirements to related design features, checks, or supporting evidence.

examples.en: The requirements matrix had one row per requirement and a separate column for the classroom check.
examples.zh: 「需求对应表」中，每项需求独占一行，另有一列填写课堂检查方式。

examples.en: Our group used the requirements matrix to find which objective still lacked a corresponding observation.
examples.zh: 我们小组用「需求对应表」找出哪项目标还缺少相应的观察结果。

words.enDefinition: A comparison of alternatives that explicitly weighs competing benefits, costs, or design objectives.

examples.en: Our trade-off analysis compared the extra storage of the larger tray with the space it occupied.
examples.zh: 我们的「权衡分析」比较了大托盘增加的储物空间与它本身占用的空间。

examples.en: We recorded the trade-off analysis before explaining why the lighter classroom model became our preferred design.
examples.zh: 我们记录了「权衡分析」，然后说明为什么最终更倾向于较轻的课堂模型。

collocations: use trade-off analysis to compare concepts

words.enDefinition: One possible solution considered alongside others for the same design problem.

examples.en: The second design alternative used two shallow compartments instead of the larger single space shown earlier.
examples.zh: 第二个「备选设计方案」采用两个浅格，替代前一个方案中的大单格。

examples.en: We drew each design alternative on its own page so classmates could compare the layouts easily.
examples.zh: 我们把各个「备选设计方案」分别画在不同页上，方便同学比较布局。

words.enDefinition: An early drawing used to communicate the main idea of a possible design.

examples.en: My concept sketch showed the tray from above and included arrows for the removable dividers.
examples.zh: 我的「概念草图」从上方画出托盘，并用箭头指出可拆卸隔板。

examples.en: The team added notes to the concept sketch after another group asked how the parts fitted together.
examples.zh: 另一组同学问部件如何拼合后，我们在「概念草图」上补了说明。

words.enDefinition: The stage of generating and refining candidate solutions for a design problem.

examples.en: During concept development, we explored three ways to arrange the compartments in the small cardboard tray.
examples.zh: 在「设计概念开发」阶段，我们探索了小纸板托盘的三种分格方式。

examples.en: The journal kept our early model photos together with the sketches from concept development.
examples.zh: 日志把早期模型照片与「设计概念开发」阶段的草图放在一起留存。

words.enDefinition: The process of choosing among candidate design concepts using stated criteria.

examples.en: We kept all three sketches until concept selection, when we compared them against the same criteria.
examples.zh: 我们保留了三幅草图，到了「设计概念筛选」阶段才按同一套准则比较。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to explain how accessibility influenced concept selection for the classroom storage model.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我们解释易用的取放方式如何影响课堂收纳模型的「设计概念筛选」。

words.enDefinition: A comparison table rating each concept against a reference concept on selected criteria.

examples.en: Our Pugh matrix used the first tray as the reference for comparing two later concepts.
examples.zh: 我们在「普氏决策矩阵」中以第一款托盘为基准，比较后来的两个方案。

examples.en: The tutor filled one row of the Pugh matrix to demonstrate comparison against the chosen baseline.
examples.zh: 辅导老师填了「普氏决策矩阵」中的一行，演示如何与选定的基准方案比较。

collocations: a reference concept in a Pugh matrix
compare options with a Pugh matrix

words.enDefinition: A documented modification to a design after an earlier version has been reviewed.

examples.en: The second design revision moved the labels to the outside edge of the cardboard tray.
examples.zh: 第二次「设计修订」把标签移到了纸板托盘的外沿。

examples.en: Our log explained the design revision beside a photograph of the earlier classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们的日志在早期课堂模型的照片旁说明了这次「设计修订」。

words.enDefinition: The intended purpose or relationships that a design is expected to preserve.

examples.en: The center marks showed the design intent that both slots should stay aligned with the tray's middle.
examples.zh: 中心标记表达了这样的「设计意图」，两个槽都应始终与托盘中部对齐。

examples.en: We added a note about design intent so the next group understood why the compartments matched.
examples.zh: 我们补了一条「设计意图」的说明，让下一组知道各储物格为什么要做成相同规格。

words.enDefinition: A tangible representation used to examine appearance, layout, or fit at an early stage.

examples.en: We made a physical mock-up from paper to see where the tray labels could sit.
examples.zh: 我们用纸做了一个「实物样模」，查看托盘标签放在哪里合适。

examples.en: We set the physical mock-up on the desk to compare its footprint with the original sketch.
examples.zh: 我们把「实物样模」放到桌上，比较它的占用面积与原草图中的面积。

words.enDefinition: A digital representation used to explore a design's geometry or behavior before making a physical version.

examples.en: We rotated the virtual prototype on screen to see whether the labels were visible from above.
examples.zh: 我们在屏幕上转动「虚拟原型」，查看从上方能否看见标签。

examples.en: The virtual prototype helped us compare how two layouts would fit on the same classroom desk.
examples.zh: 「虚拟原型」帮助我们比较两种布局放在同一张课桌上的效果。

collocations: test the fit in a virtual prototype

words.enDefinition: Checking objective evidence that the design meets specified requirements.

examples.en: We used design verification to check the tray dimensions against the values in our requirements sheet.
examples.zh: 我们用「设计验证」核对托盘尺寸是否满足需求表中的数值。

examples.en: The design verification table showed which measurements supported each stated requirement for the classroom model.
examples.zh: 「设计验证」表显示，哪些测量结果支持课堂模型的各项既定要求。

words.enDefinition: Checking that a design satisfies intended user needs in its expected context of use.

examples.en: For design validation, classmates tried finding index cards in the tray during a simulated study session.
examples.zh: 为进行「设计确认」，同学们在模拟自习场景中尝试从托盘里找索引卡。

examples.en: Our design validation notes described how the organizer performed when students actually used it on their desks.
examples.zh: 「设计确认」记录描述了学生在桌上实际使用收纳盒时的表现。

words.enDefinition: A stated condition used to decide whether a result meets a requirement.

examples.en: We wrote an acceptance criterion before checking whether the model slid easily into the classroom drawer.
examples.zh: 我们先写明「验收判据」，再检查模型是否能轻松滑进教室的抽屉。

examples.en: The tutor linked each acceptance criterion on the page to a result our group could observe.
examples.zh: 辅导老师把页面上的各项「验收判据」与我们小组可观察到的结果一一对应。

words.enDefinition: A physical or environmental condition under which a test is performed.

examples.en: We recorded the test condition beside each observation so another group could interpret the classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 我们在各项观察结果旁写明「试验条件」，让另一组也能理解课堂比较结果。

examples.en: Room temperature was the test condition we kept the same for both samples in the classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 课堂比较中，我们让两个样品保持一致的「试验条件」是室温。

collocations: repeat a test under the same test condition

words.enDefinition: A piece of material or component prepared or selected for a test.

examples.en: Each test specimen carried a code that matched its row in the classroom results table.
examples.zh: 每件「试件」都有编号，与课堂结果表中的对应行一致。

examples.en: We chose a second test specimen from the same batch for the comparison in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 在习题的比较中，我们从同一批次选出第二件「试件」。

collocations: a test specimen from a batch

words.enDefinition: A milestone after which a design version is held fixed except for formally agreed changes.

examples.en: After design freeze, the class used the same tray drawing for every copy of the model.
examples.zh: 「设计定版」后，课堂上的每件模型都使用了同一份托盘图纸。

examples.en: We noted the design freeze date beside the final classroom drawing in our shared project folder.
examples.zh: 我们在共享项目文件夹里，把「设计定版」日期记在最后一版课堂图纸旁。

collocations: review the drawing before design freeze

words.enDefinition: A technical representation that communicates an object's shape, size, or related requirements.

examples.en: The engineering drawing showed the tray from several sides so classmates could understand its shape.
examples.zh: 「工程图样」从多个方向展示托盘，方便同学理解它的形状。

examples.en: We compared the engineering drawing with the classroom model before discussing the missing dimension.
examples.zh: 讨论缺失的尺寸之前，我们先将「工程图样」与课堂模型作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A drawing method projecting features onto a plane along parallel lines perpendicular to that plane.

examples.en: We used orthographic projection to draw the top and front views of the same model.
examples.zh: 我们用「正投影法」画出同一模型的俯视图和正视图。

examples.en: The tutor compared orthographic projection with the pictorial sketch to explain why hidden edges needed separate marks.
examples.zh: 辅导老师将「正投影法」画出的图与立体草图比较，解释隐藏边为何需要单独标注。

words.enDefinition: A pictorial drawing using the same scale along three equally spaced axes.

examples.en: The isometric drawing let us see the top and two sides of the cardboard model at once.
examples.zh: 用「等轴测图」，我们可以同时看到纸板模型的顶面和两个侧面。

examples.en: Our worksheet placed the isometric drawing beside the separate front and side views of the part.
examples.zh: 习题把「等轴测图」放在部件各自的正视图和侧视图旁边。

collocations: an isometric drawing of a part

words.enDefinition: A view showing internal features revealed by an imagined cut through an object.

examples.en: The section view revealed the slot hidden inside the small block in our classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图纸上的「剖视图」显出了小方块里原先看不见的槽。

examples.en: We checked the section view to see where the two layers of the sample touched.
examples.zh: 我们查看「剖视图」，确认样品的两层在哪里接触。

collocations: a section view through the center

words.enDefinition: A drawing line marking the location and viewing direction of an imagined cut for a section view.

examples.en: The arrows on the cutting plane line showed which way to look through the center of the block.
examples.zh: 「剖切位置线」上的箭头指出剖开方块中央后应从哪个方向看。

examples.en: We matched the letters on the cutting plane line to the label above the section view.
examples.zh: 我们把「剖切位置线」上的字母与剖视图上方的标记对应起来。

collocations: arrows on a cutting plane line

words.enDefinition: An enlarged view of a selected part of a drawing that makes local features clearer.

examples.en: The detail view made the small notch visible without enlarging the rest of the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 「局部放大图」让小缺口清晰可见，其余课堂图样仍按原比例显示。

examples.en: The tutor followed a circular label to find the detail view of the tray corner.
examples.zh: 辅导老师根据圆圈标记找到了托盘转角的「局部放大图」。

words.enDefinition: A dashed drawing line representing an edge or feature concealed from the chosen view.

examples.en: The hidden line marked the far side of the slot that we could not see directly.
examples.zh: 「不可见轮廓线」标出了视线无法直达的槽的另一侧。

examples.en: We added a hidden line to the front view after looking at the model from above.
examples.zh: 从上方看过模型后，我们在正视图中补画了一条「不可见轮廓线」。

words.enDefinition: A drawing line marking an axis, center, or line of symmetry.

examples.en: The centerline passed through the middle of both round holes in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图纸上的「中心线」穿过两个圆孔的中心。

examples.en: We used the centerline to locate the position of each slot relative to the model's symmetry.
examples.zh: 我们用「中心线」确定各个槽相对于模型对称轴的位置。

collocations: mark the centerline of a hole

words.enDefinition: A line showing the direction and extent of a dimension, typically marked with arrowheads.

examples.en: The dimension line ran between the two arrows under the classroom drawing of the rectangular tray.
examples.zh: 「尺寸线」位于矩形托盘课堂图样下方的两个箭头之间。

examples.en: We checked whether the number above the dimension line referred to the length or the width.
examples.zh: 我们核对「尺寸线」上方的数字表示长度还是宽度。

collocations: an arrowhead on a dimension line

words.enDefinition: A line extending from a feature to indicate where a dimension begins or ends.

examples.en: The extension line rose from the corner to show where the width measurement started in the sketch.
examples.zh: 「尺寸界线」从转角向上延伸，指出草图中宽度标注的起点。

examples.en: We followed the extension line back to the edge that the dimension referred to in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们沿「尺寸界线」找到了这个尺寸指向的边。

collocations: an extension line from an edge

words.enDefinition: A line connecting a note, symbol, or dimension to the feature it describes.

examples.en: The leader line pointed from the written note to the small notch in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 「引出线」从文字说明指向课堂图样中的小缺口。

examples.en: The tutor moved the label but kept the end of its leader line on the same edge.
examples.zh: 辅导老师移动了标签，「引出线」末端仍指在同一条边上。

collocations: a leader line pointing to a feature
attach a note with a leader line

words.enDefinition: The ratio between a length in a drawing and the corresponding actual length.

examples.en: We read the drawing scale before comparing the printed sketch with the actual size of the model.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「图样比例」，再将印出来的草图与模型实际大小比较。

examples.en: The detail used a different drawing scale so we could see the slot shape more clearly.
examples.zh: 详图采用不同的「图样比例」，使我们能更清楚地看到槽的形状。

collocations: a drawing scale in the title block

words.enDefinition: The named or intended size used as a reference for a feature or part.

examples.en: The instructional drawing gave a nominal dimension for the block while the table showed individual measurements.
examples.zh: 教学图样给出方块的「公称尺寸」，表格则列出各次实测值。

examples.en: We recorded the nominal dimension next to our first reading to make the difference clear.
examples.zh: 我们把「公称尺寸」写在首次读数旁，以清楚显示两者的差异。

collocations: compare a reading with a nominal dimension
a nominal dimension on a drawing

words.enDefinition: An informational dimension, often derived from other dimensions, that sets no separate requirement.

examples.en: The reference dimension helped us understand the drawing even though it did not add a separate requirement.
examples.zh: 「参考尺寸」帮助我们理解图样，而且不会增加独立的要求。

examples.en: We found the reference dimension by adding the two shorter distances shown in the classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 我们把课堂草图里的两段较短距离相加，得到「参考尺寸」。

words.enDefinition: A dimension measured between the extreme points of a part in a given direction.

examples.en: The overall dimension included the handle because the organizer had to fit inside the teaching drawer.
examples.zh: 由于收纳盒要放进教学抽屉，「外廓尺寸」也包括把手。

examples.en: We checked the overall dimension along the longest side before comparing the two tray sketches.
examples.zh: 我们先核对最长边方向的「外廓尺寸」，再比较两张托盘草图。

collocations: an overall dimension of a model

words.enDefinition: The stated largest and smallest permissible sizes for a feature.

examples.en: The worksheet gave two limit dimensions for the slot instead of one size with a tolerance.
examples.zh: 习题直接给出槽的两个「极限尺寸」。

examples.en: We compared the measured width with both limit dimensions shown on the sample drawing in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将实测宽度与示例图样上的两个「极限尺寸」比较。

words.enDefinition: The permitted variation in the size of a feature.

examples.en: The dimensional tolerance defined the allowed range around the nominal width in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 课堂题中的「尺寸公差」规定了公称宽度周围的允许范围。

examples.en: The class checked the dimensional tolerance before interpreting differences among the measurements of the model slots.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先核对「尺寸公差」，再解释模型各槽的实测差异。

words.enDefinition: A size tolerance allowing departures in both directions from the stated nominal dimension.

examples.en: The bilateral tolerance allowed the sample width to fall slightly above or below the nominal value.
examples.zh: 「双向公差」允许试样宽度略高于或略低于公称值。

examples.en: We identified a bilateral tolerance when the drawing showed deviations both above and below the nominal dimension.
examples.zh: 图样显示公称尺寸上、下都允许有偏差，我们据此认出了「双向公差」。

collocations: show a bilateral tolerance beside a dimension

words.enDefinition: A size tolerance allowing departure in only one direction from the stated nominal dimension.

examples.en: The unilateral tolerance allowed a smaller width but set the nominal width as the maximum.
examples.zh: 「单向公差」允许宽度更小，并以公称宽度为上限。

examples.en: We identified a unilateral tolerance in the exercise because one of the stated deviations was zero.
examples.zh: 练习中，标注的一项偏差为零，我们据此认出了「单向公差」。

collocations: a unilateral tolerance below nominal size

words.enDefinition: The combined effect of variations in individual dimensions on an assembly dimension or fit.

examples.en: The tolerance stack-up explained why small size differences in several model pieces changed the final assembly length.
examples.zh: 「公差累积」解释了为什么几个模型零件的小尺寸差异会改变装配后的总长。

examples.en: We sketched the relevant dimensions before discussing tolerance stack-up in the tray and divider assembly.
examples.zh: 讨论托盘与隔板装配中的「公差累积」前，我们先画出相关尺寸。

words.enDefinition: A fit whose permitted dimensions allow mating parts to assemble without dimensional interference.

examples.en: The example used a clearance fit so the paper tube sat loosely inside its outer ring.
examples.zh: 例题采用「间隙配合」，让纸管可以较松地套在外环里。

examples.en: We identified the clearance fit after comparing the allowed sizes in the classroom drawing's table.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂图样表格中的允许尺寸后，认出了「间隙配合」。

collocations: a clearance fit between mating parts

words.enDefinition: A fit whose permitted dimensions make a mating outer feature larger than its matching opening.

examples.en: The diagram illustrated an interference fit by showing the model insert slightly wider than the opening.
examples.zh: 示意图显示模型嵌件略宽于开口，以说明「过盈配合」。

examples.en: The tutor asked which size limits represented an interference fit in the simplified classroom assembly example.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，在简化的课堂装配例题中，哪些尺寸极限表示「过盈配合」。

collocations: an interference fit between mating parts

words.enDefinition: A fit that can produce clearance or interference depending on the actual mating dimensions.

examples.en: Our transition fit example showed that two acceptable pairs of parts could produce different mating conditions.
examples.zh: 「过渡配合」例题显示，两对尺寸均合格的零件可能形成不同的配合状态。

examples.en: We identified a transition fit because the stated size ranges allowed either clearance or interference.
examples.zh: 规定的尺寸范围允许形成间隙或过盈，我们据此认出「过渡配合」。

collocations: a transition fit between mating parts

words.enDefinition: An ideal point, axis, plane, or other reference from which features are located or oriented.

examples.en: The exercise used the bottom plane as a datum for locating the holes in the model.
examples.zh: 练习以底部平面为「基准」，确定模型各孔的位置。

examples.en: We chose a second datum to describe how the markings were aligned across the panel.
examples.zh: 我们选了第二个「基准」，描述面板上各标记如何对齐。

collocations: refer a dimension to a datum

words.enDefinition: An actual part feature used to establish an ideal datum.

examples.en: The underside of the block was the datum feature used to establish a reference plane in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，方块底面作为「基准要素」，用来建立一个参考平面。

examples.en: We pointed to the datum feature on the classroom model after locating its mark on the drawing.
examples.zh: 在图样上找到标识后，我们在课堂模型上指出了「基准要素」。

collocations: a datum feature indicated on a drawing

words.enDefinition: A specified limit on variation in a feature's form, orientation, location, or runout.

examples.en: The geometric tolerance concerned the orientation of the model's upright face relative to its bottom plane.
examples.zh: 「几何公差」规定了模型直立面相对于底平面的方向允许偏差。

examples.en: We read the geometric tolerance next to the feature symbol before discussing the classroom inspection example.
examples.zh: 讨论课堂检验示例之前，我们先读了要素符号旁的「几何公差」。

collocations: a geometric tolerance on a drawing

words.enDefinition: The maximum permitted separation of two parallel planes enclosing the actual surface.

examples.en: The worksheet compared the flatness tolerance with a sketch showing the two planes that bounded the surface.
examples.zh: 习题用一幅草图说明「平面度公差」，表面须落在图示两个平面之间。

examples.en: We discussed why the flatness tolerance was relevant to the tray base in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么「平面度公差」对课堂图样中的托盘底面有意义。

collocations: a flatness tolerance for a surface

words.enDefinition: A limit on variation from a right-angle orientation relative to a specified datum.

examples.en: The drawing used a perpendicularity tolerance for the upright face relative to the model's bottom plane.
examples.zh: 图样给模型直立面相对于底平面标注了「垂直度公差」。

examples.en: We located the referenced datum before interpreting the perpendicularity tolerance in the classroom example drawing.
examples.zh: 我们先找到引用的基准，再解读课堂示例图样上的「垂直度公差」。

collocations: a perpendicularity tolerance relative to a datum

words.enDefinition: A limit on variation from a parallel orientation relative to a specified datum.

examples.en: The parallelism tolerance described how closely the top face had to follow the model's bottom reference plane.
examples.zh: 「平行度公差」规定了顶面须在多大程度上与模型的底部参考平面保持平行。

examples.en: We found the parallelism tolerance beside the upper surface symbol on our classroom example drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示例图样的上表面符号旁找到了「平行度公差」。

collocations: a parallelism tolerance for a surface

words.enDefinition: A drawing mark communicating a requirement or information about a part's surface texture.

examples.en: The tutor pointed to the surface finish symbol beside the face highlighted in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 辅导老师指出了课堂图样中高亮表面旁的「表面状态符号」。

examples.en: We found the surface finish symbol near the edge that appeared smoother in the pictured model.
examples.zh: 我们在图示模型中看起来较光滑的边缘附近找到了「表面状态符号」。

collocations: a surface finish symbol on a drawing

words.enDefinition: The small-scale irregularities in a surface's texture considered over a specified length or area.

examples.en: The surface roughness differed between the two sample blocks even though their shapes looked identical.
examples.zh: 两个试样块的形状看起来一样，但「表面粗糙度」不同。

examples.en: The classroom report discussed surface roughness separately from the larger waviness visible in the model sketch.
examples.zh: 课堂报告分别讨论了「表面粗糙度」和模型草图中可见的较大波纹。

words.enDefinition: A drawing table that records changes along with identifiers such as revision labels or dates.

examples.en: We looked at the revision block to see which drawing version moved the slot in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们查看「修订栏」，找出哪一版图样更改了课堂模型上槽的位置。

examples.en: The tutor found the change description and its date in the same revision block row.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在「修订栏」的同一行找到了变更说明和日期。

collocations: an entry in the revision block

words.enDefinition: An area identifying a drawing and giving details such as its title, number, or scale.

examples.en: The drawing title block gave the sheet number and scale for the model assembly in our exercise.
examples.zh: 「图样标题栏」给出了练习中模型装配图的图号和比例。

examples.en: We checked the drawing title block to make sure both pages belonged to the same classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们核对「图样标题栏」，确认两页图样都属于同一个课堂模型。

collocations: a scale in the drawing title block
the drawing number in the drawing title block

words.enDefinition: A view showing assembly components separated to clarify their relative locations and arrangement.

examples.en: The exploded view spaced the tray pieces apart so we could see their order of assembly.
examples.zh: 「爆炸装配图」把托盘的各个部件分开画，方便我们看清装配顺序。

examples.en: Our tutor used the exploded view to match each photographed piece with its numbered drawing label.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用「爆炸装配图」，将照片中的各个部件与图样上的编号对应起来。

collocations: an exploded view of an assembly

words.enDefinition: Repeated lines or patterns marking solid material intersected by an imagined cutting plane.

examples.en: The section hatching marked the solid material around the slot in the block's imagined cut.
examples.zh: 「剖面线」标出了假想切开方块后槽周围的实体部分。

examples.en: We removed the section hatching from the empty space after comparing the drawing with the classroom model.
examples.zh: 将图样与课堂模型比较后，我们删去了空白区域中的「剖面线」。

words.enDefinition: The study and application of measurement principles to engineering work.

examples.en: The engineering metrology lesson used two rulers to show why a recorded value needs context.
examples.zh: 「工程计量学」课用两把尺说明，为什么报告读数还需要说明测量背景。

examples.en: Our engineering metrology assignment asked us to explain what made the two length measurements comparable.
examples.zh: 「工程计量学」作业要求我们解释，这两次长度测量为何可以作比较。

words.enDefinition: A material measure, instrument, or system realizing a reference quantity value with known uncertainty.

examples.en: The tutor used a measurement standard with a documented length to check the classroom instrument.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用长度有记录的「计量标准」检查课堂仪器。

examples.en: We traced the value of the measurement standard to the reference named on the sample certificate.
examples.zh: 我们把「计量标准」的量值追溯到证书样例所注明的参考来源。

collocations: compare an instrument with a measurement standard

words.enDefinition: The particular quantity intended to be measured.

examples.en: The measurand was the slot's width at the center of the classroom sample's marked face.
examples.zh: 「被测量」是课堂样品标记面中央处的槽宽。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to define the measurand before choosing which readings belonged in the table.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我们先说清楚「被测量」，再决定哪些读数写入表中。

words.enDefinition: Establishing how an instrument's indications relate to known reference values and their uncertainties.

examples.en: The instrument calibration notes compared the displayed lengths with the values listed for the reference pieces.
examples.zh: 「仪器校准」记录把仪器显示的长度与参考件标注的量值作了比较。

examples.en: We consulted the instrument calibration record before interpreting the difference between the laboratory readings.
examples.zh: 解释实验室读数之间的差异之前，我们先查阅了「仪器校准」记录。

words.enDefinition: A document reporting calibration results and relevant information such as uncertainties and conditions.

examples.en: The sample calibration certificate listed the reference values and the uncertainty associated with each reported result.
examples.zh: 「校准证书」样例列出了参考值和各项报告结果对应的不确定度。

examples.en: We matched the instrument number on the calibration certificate with the number shown in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把「校准证书」上的仪器编号与习题中显示的编号对应起来。

collocations: a result on a calibration certificate
the uncertainty on a calibration certificate

words.enDefinition: A specified reference value or setting at which a calibration comparison is made.

examples.en: The lowest calibration point corresponded to the shortest reference piece in the classroom data table.
examples.zh: 课堂数据表中，最低的「校准点」对应最短的参考件。

examples.en: We traced the calibration point on the chart back to the reading recorded for that reference length.
examples.zh: 我们根据图表上的「校准点」，找到了该参考长度对应的读数记录。

collocations: a reading at a calibration point
record data for each calibration point

words.enDefinition: A measurement result's documented link to a reference through an unbroken calibration chain with associated uncertainties.

examples.en: The worksheet illustrated metrological traceability by linking the classroom result to successive references and calibration records.
examples.zh: 习题将课堂测量结果与逐级参考量值及校准记录关联起来，说明「计量溯源性」。

examples.en: We discussed metrological traceability after noticing that the sample certificate named a reference and an uncertainty.
examples.zh: 我们注意到证书样例注明了参考来源及不确定度，随后讨论了「计量溯源性」。

words.enDefinition: A quantity value used as a basis for comparison with another value.

examples.en: We placed the reference value beside each measured value to make the comparison easier to read.
examples.zh: 我们把「参考量值」写在各个测量值旁边，让对照更容易读懂。

examples.en: The reference value in the example came from the label supplied with the classroom gauge block.
examples.zh: 例题中的「参考量值」来自课堂量块附带的标签。

collocations: compare a reading with a reference value

words.enDefinition: The span of quantity values an instrument can measure under stated conditions.

examples.en: We checked the measurement range before choosing an instrument for the longest sample on the tray.
examples.zh: 给托盘上最长的样品选择仪器之前，我们先核对「测量范围」。

examples.en: The report marked readings outside the measurement range so students could interpret the table correctly.
examples.zh: 报告标出了超出「测量范围」的读数，方便学生正确解读表格。

collocations: the upper limit of the measurement range

words.enDefinition: The smallest change in the measured quantity that produces a perceptible change in an instrument's indication.

examples.en: The instrument resolution mattered because the two classroom blocks differed in length by only a little.
examples.zh: 两个课堂方块的长度相差很小，因此「仪器分辨力」很重要。

examples.en: We compared instrument resolution before interpreting why the displays showed the same number for both samples.
examples.zh: 我们先比较「仪器分辨力」，再解释为何仪器对两件样品显示相同数字。

words.enDefinition: The interval between neighboring marks on an instrument's marked scale.

examples.en: Each scale division on the pictured ruler represented the same length in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂例题中，图中尺子的每一「标尺分度」都对应相同的长度。

examples.en: We checked the value of one scale division before recording the reading shown in the photograph.
examples.zh: 记录照片所示读数前，我们先核对一个「标尺分度」所代表的值。

collocations: the value of one scale division

words.enDefinition: A nonzero instrument indication when the measured input has a reference value of zero.

examples.en: The display showed a small zero offset while the reference input was still set to zero.
examples.zh: 参考输入仍为零时，显示器给出了一个小的「零点偏移」。

examples.en: We marked the zero offset in the practice table before comparing the two classroom instruments.
examples.zh: 比较两台课堂仪器之前，我们在练习表中标出了「零点偏移」。

words.enDefinition: Adjusting an instrument so that its indication matches the zero reference condition.

examples.en: The page listed zero adjustment as a separate item before the recorded classroom measurement comparisons.
examples.zh: 页面把「零点调整」单独列在课堂测量对照记录之前。

examples.en: We discussed zero adjustment after the diagram showed an instrument with a nonzero reading at rest.
examples.zh: 图中仪器在零输入状态下读数不为零，于是我们讨论了「零点调整」。

collocations: the result of a zero adjustment

words.enDefinition: A change in an instrument's zero indication over time with its reference input held at zero.

examples.en: The chart showed zero drift because the indicated baseline moved while the reference stayed at zero.
examples.zh: 图中的指示基线发生移动，而参考输入始终为零，显示出「零点漂移」。

examples.en: We checked for zero drift by comparing the original and final baseline entries on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较习题中最初和最后的基线记录，以查看有无「零点漂移」。

collocations: account for zero drift in the results

words.enDefinition: An estimate of the systematic part of the difference between measured values and a reference.

examples.en: The readings clustered above the reference value, suggesting positive measurement bias in the classroom data.
examples.zh: 课堂数据中的读数集中在参考量值之上，提示存在正的「测量偏倚」。

examples.en: We estimated measurement bias from the average difference between repeated readings and their shared reference value.
examples.zh: 我们根据重复读数与共同参考量值的平均差估算「测量偏倚」。

words.enDefinition: How closely a measured value agrees with the true value of the quantity being measured.

examples.en: The tutor discussed measurement accuracy after comparing the readings with the documented reference length in class.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在课上将读数与记录的参考长度作比较后，讨论了「测量准确度」。

examples.en: We considered measurement accuracy when one ruler consistently gave values farther from the model's reference length.
examples.zh: 一把尺的读数始终偏离模型参考长度更远，我们因此考虑了「测量准确度」。

words.enDefinition: How closely the average of many repeated measurements agrees with a reference value.

examples.en: We discussed measurement trueness by comparing the average of repeated readings with the stated reference length.
examples.zh: 我们将重复读数的平均值与所给参考长度比较，讨论了「测量正确度」。

examples.en: The example showed lower measurement trueness when the readings clustered around a value above the reference.
examples.zh: 例题中的读数集中在高于参考量值的位置，说明「测量正确度」较低。

words.enDefinition: The agreement among repeated measurements made under specified conditions.

examples.en: The closely grouped readings showed good measurement precision under the repeated conditions used in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂采用的重复测量条件下，读数聚得很紧，表明「测量精密度」较高。

examples.en: We compared measurement precision by plotting the spread of readings from both groups of students.
examples.zh: 我们画出两组学生读数的分散程度，以比较「测量精密度」。

words.enDefinition: The measured value minus a reference value for the quantity being measured.

examples.en: The measurement error was negative because the displayed reading fell below the reference value in the table.
examples.zh: 显示读数低于表中的参考量值，因此「测量误差」为负。

examples.en: We kept units beside the measurement error so readers could interpret each value in context.
examples.zh: 我们在「测量误差」旁保留单位，方便读者结合上下文理解各个值。

collocations: identify a source of measurement error

words.enDefinition: The component of measurement error that remains constant or varies predictably under repeated measurements.

examples.en: The simulation introduced a systematic measurement error by adding the same offset to every reading.
examples.zh: 模拟给所有读数都加上同一个偏移量，从而引入「系统测量误差」。

examples.en: We investigated systematic measurement error after seeing that each reading missed the reference in the same direction.
examples.zh: 发现各次读数都朝同一方向偏离参考值后，我们研究了「系统测量误差」。

collocations: an example of systematic measurement error

words.enDefinition: The component of measurement error that varies unpredictably among repeated measurements.

examples.en: The classroom simulation added random measurement error so successive readings scattered around their average value.
examples.zh: 课堂模拟加入「随机测量误差」，使连续读数散布在均值周围。

examples.en: We compared random measurement error between the two simulated instruments using the spread of repeated readings.
examples.zh: 我们根据重复读数的分散程度比较两台模拟仪器的「随机测量误差」。

collocations: the effect of random measurement error
reduce the contribution of random measurement error

words.enDefinition: A numerical description of how widely the values reasonably attributable to a measurand may be dispersed.

examples.en: We reported the uncertainty of measurement beside the length so readers could interpret the result properly.
examples.zh: 我们将「测量不确定度」写在长度值旁，让读者能正确解读结果。

examples.en: The tutor asked what contributed to the uncertainty of measurement in the classroom length comparison.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，课堂长度比较中的「测量不确定度」由哪些因素造成。

words.enDefinition: A summary identifying the sources of uncertainty and their contributions to a measurement result.

examples.en: Our uncertainty budget listed the contributions from repeat readings and the reference used for comparison.
examples.zh: 我们的「不确定度分量表」列出了重复读数和所用参考量值各自的贡献。

examples.en: We checked the uncertainty budget to see which contribution was largest in the synthetic classroom data.
examples.zh: 我们核对「不确定度分量表」，看课堂合成数据中哪项贡献最大。

collocations: an entry in an uncertainty budget

words.enDefinition: An uncertainty expressed as a standard deviation.

examples.en: The table expressed standard uncertainty in the same length unit as the reported classroom measurement.
examples.zh: 表中「标准不确定度」采用与课堂报告测量值相同的长度单位。

examples.en: The tutor identified which standard uncertainty came from the spread of readings in the practice data.
examples.zh: 辅导老师指出，练习数据中的哪项「标准不确定度」来自读数的分散程度。

words.enDefinition: Combined standard uncertainty multiplied by a stated coverage factor.

examples.en: We reported expanded uncertainty together with the multiplier used in the classroom measurement example.
examples.zh: 在课堂测量示例中，我们同时报告了「扩展不确定度」及所用的乘数。

examples.en: The second row gave the same measured length but a larger expanded uncertainty than our example.
examples.zh: 第二行给出的测得长度相同，但「扩展不确定度」比我们示例中的更大。

collocations: an expanded uncertainty with a stated coverage factor

words.enDefinition: The multiplier that scales combined standard uncertainty to obtain expanded uncertainty.

examples.en: The worksheet asked us to find the coverage factor printed next to the expanded uncertainty.
examples.zh: 习题让我们找出印在扩展不确定度旁的「包含因子」。

examples.en: We checked whether both examples used the same coverage factor before comparing their expanded uncertainties.
examples.zh: 比较两个示例的扩展不确定度之前，我们先核对它们是否使用相同的「包含因子」。

collocations: apply a coverage factor to combined standard uncertainty

words.enDefinition: Measurement precision under the same procedure, equipment, observer, and similar short-term conditions.

examples.en: We assessed measurement repeatability from readings taken by the same student with the same classroom instrument.
examples.zh: 我们根据同一学生用同一课堂仪器取得的读数，评估「测量重复性」。

examples.en: The tutor kept the procedure and setup fixed while the group discussed measurement repeatability in class.
examples.zh: 小组在课上讨论「测量重复性」时，辅导老师保持方法和装置不变。

words.enDefinition: Measurement precision under stated changes in conditions, such as location, observer, or equipment.

examples.en: The class discussed measurement reproducibility after examining readings from students using different instruments and rooms.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们查看学生在不同房间用不同仪器取得的读数后，讨论了「测量复现性」。

examples.en: We described the changed conditions before comparing measurement reproducibility across the two classroom groups.
examples.zh: 比较两个课堂小组的「测量复现性」之前，我们先说明哪些条件发生了改变。

words.enDefinition: A reading error caused by viewing a scale and pointer from a displaced angle.

examples.en: The two photographs illustrated parallax error by showing the same pointer from two different viewing positions.
examples.zh: 两张照片从不同位置拍摄同一个指针，展示了「视差误差」。

examples.en: We discussed parallax error after the indicated mark appeared to shift when the camera moved.
examples.zh: 相机一移动，指针所指的刻度看起来就变了，我们据此讨论了「视差误差」。

collocations: parallax error when reading a scale

words.enDefinition: The difference obtained by subtracting a reference quantity value from an instrument's indication.

examples.en: The indication error was positive where the instrument displayed a value above the reference length.
examples.zh: 仪器显示值高于参考长度的位置，「示值误差」为正。

examples.en: We used separate columns for the displayed reading and indication error in the calibration example.
examples.zh: 在校准示例中，我们分列显示读数和「示值误差」。

collocations: the indication error at a calibration point

words.enDefinition: The change in an instrument's indication divided by the corresponding change in the measured quantity.

examples.en: We compared measurement sensitivity by examining the slopes of the two curves in the response plot.
examples.zh: 我们查看响应图中两条曲线的斜率，以比较「测量灵敏度」。

examples.en: The tutor explained measurement sensitivity using examples where equal input changes produced different changes in indication.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用等量输入变化产生不同示值变化的例子说明「测量灵敏度」。

collocations: measurement sensitivity from a response curve

words.enDefinition: A difference in indications for the same input depending on whether that input approached from above or below.

examples.en: The chart showed instrument hysteresis where increasing and decreasing inputs produced different readings at equal values.
examples.zh: 当增加和减小输入在相同输入值处产生不同读数时，图中显示出「仪器回程差」。

examples.en: We marked the gap between the two traces to illustrate instrument hysteresis in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们标出两条曲线之间的间距，说明课堂模型中的「仪器回程差」。

collocations: instrument hysteresis on a response plot

words.enDefinition: A caliper that displays the distance between its measuring faces as a numerical reading.

examples.en: The photograph showed a digital caliper beside the classroom block, with its reading clearly visible.
examples.zh: 照片上，课堂方块旁放着一把「数显卡尺」，示值清晰可见。

examples.en: We identified the digital caliper from its numeric display in the illustrated list of instruments.
examples.zh: 我们根据数字显示屏，在带插图的仪器清单中认出了「数显卡尺」。

collocations: measure width with a digital caliper

words.enDefinition: A caliper with a sliding auxiliary scale for reading fractions of a main scale division.

examples.en: We used the diagram to identify the sliding scale of the vernier caliper in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用示意图找到「游标卡尺」的滑动标尺。

examples.en: The tutor placed a vernier caliper next to a plain ruler so we could compare their scales.
examples.zh: 辅导老师把一把「游标卡尺」放在普通尺旁，让我们比较两者的刻度。

collocations: measure a diameter with a vernier caliper

words.enDefinition: A measuring tool whose precision screw moves one face to measure a small dimension.

examples.en: The classroom diagram of the micrometer screw gauge labeled the spindle next to the sample.
examples.zh: 课堂「螺旋测微器」示意图在样品旁标出了测微螺杆。

examples.en: We identified the micrometer screw gauge in the photo by its frame and round thimble.
examples.zh: 我们根据尺架和圆形微分筒，从照片中认出了「螺旋测微器」。

collocations: measure thickness with a micrometer screw gauge

words.enDefinition: An instrument using a dial and pointer to show small displacements of a contact probe.

examples.en: The dial indicator showed a pointer moving around the marked face in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 课堂动画中，「指针式指示表」的指针沿刻度盘移动。

examples.en: The drawing placed the dial indicator beside the surface whose small movement we were comparing.
examples.zh: 图中，「指针式指示表」放在我们要比较微小位移的表面旁。

collocations: a dial indicator with a contact probe

words.enDefinition: A precision block with a calibrated length used as a dimensional reference.

examples.en: The instructor displayed a gauge block and its stated length beside the worksheet's instrument image.
examples.zh: 老师在习题的仪器图旁展示了一个「量块」和它标注的长度。

examples.en: We linked the gauge block label to the reference value entered in the classroom calibration table.
examples.zh: 我们把「量块」标签与课堂校准表中录入的参考量值对应起来。

collocations: compare an instrument with a gauge block

words.enDefinition: A gauge that checks whether a feature fits within limits without giving a numerical size.

examples.en: The go/no-go gauge checked the model opening against size limits without displaying its diameter.
examples.zh: 「通止规」核对模型开口是否满足尺寸极限，无需显示直径。

examples.en: We recognized the go/no-go gauge by the two ends illustrated in the worksheet's tool drawing.
examples.zh: 我们根据习题工具图中画出的两个端部认出了「通止规」。

collocations: a go/no-go gauge for a hole

words.enDefinition: Text accompanying a measurement result that identifies its uncertainty and how to interpret it.

examples.en: Our uncertainty statement gave the expanded uncertainty, its unit and the coverage factor beside the result.
examples.zh: 我们在结果旁附上「不确定度声明」，列出扩展不确定度、单位和包含因子。

examples.en: We read the uncertainty statement to understand what the reported interval meant in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「不确定度声明」，以了解课堂例题所报告的区间含义。

collocations: read an uncertainty statement in a report

words.enDefinition: A specific feature or property selected for examination against an inspection requirement.

examples.en: The inspection characteristic in the first row was the width of the slot in the model.
examples.zh: 第一行的「检验特性」是模型上的槽宽。

examples.en: We linked each inspection characteristic to the relevant note on the simplified drawing used in class.
examples.zh: 我们把各项「检验特性」与课堂简化图样上的相应说明关联起来。

collocations: an inspection characteristic on a checklist

words.enDefinition: Examining measured dimensions to see whether a physical item meets stated dimensional requirements.

examples.en: The dimensional inspection table listed measured widths beside the model's stated limit dimensions in our exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「尺寸检验」表在模型的规定极限尺寸旁列出实测宽度。

examples.en: We separated dimensional inspection from the discussion of the sample's appearance in the classroom report.
examples.zh: 在课堂报告中，我们把「尺寸检验」和试样外观的讨论分开。

words.enDefinition: Examining an item by sight to check its visible features or condition.

examples.en: The visual inspection identified a torn edge on the paper model shown in the classroom photograph.
examples.zh: 「目视检验」发现课堂照片里的纸模型有一处边缘撕裂。

examples.en: We used visual inspection to compare the appearance of the two samples under the same lighting.
examples.zh: 我们采用「目视检验」，在相同光照下比较两个试样的外观。

words.enDefinition: Checking the first item produced in a run before evaluating or continuing the rest.

examples.en: The classroom exercise used first-piece inspection to compare the first paper tray with the model drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂练习通过「首件检验」，将做出的第一个纸托盘与模型图样对照。

examples.en: We marked first-piece inspection on the practice chart beside the first numbered sample from each group.
examples.zh: 我们在练习图表中每组首件编号样品旁标出了「首件检验」。

words.enDefinition: Checking received items or materials against requirements before they are accepted for use.

examples.en: The diagram placed incoming inspection next to the delivery of sample pieces for the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 示意图把「进料检验」放在课堂练习接收样件的环节旁边。

examples.en: Our incoming inspection exercise compared the delivered cardboard shapes with the list attached to their package.
examples.zh: 「进料检验」练习中，我们将收到的纸板形状与包装附带的清单作了对照。

words.enDefinition: An examination performed during production or assembly before the item is complete.

examples.en: The flowchart marked in-process inspection after one assembly step but before the cardboard model was complete.
examples.zh: 流程图把「过程检验」标在某个装配步骤之后、纸板模型全部完成之前。

examples.en: We reviewed the in-process inspection notes to see when the misaligned label first appeared in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们查阅「过程检验」记录，找出练习中标签第一次贴偏是在何时。

words.enDefinition: A check of a completed item against applicable requirements before it is accepted or released.

examples.en: The final inspection compared the completed classroom model with the list of features on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 「最终检验」将完成的课堂模型与习题上的特性清单作了对照。

examples.en: Our tutor kept the final inspection record separate from the observations of the partially assembled model.
examples.zh: 辅导老师将「最终检验」记录与部分装配模型的观察记录分开。

words.enDefinition: A document capturing what was examined, the observed results, and other details of an inspection.

examples.en: The inspection record showed which model was checked and which dimensions the student had measured.
examples.zh: 「检验记录」显示了检查的是哪个模型，以及学生测了哪些尺寸。

examples.en: We added the photograph number to the inspection record so another group could find the same example.
examples.zh: 我们把照片编号填入「检验记录」，方便另一组找到同一个示例。

collocations: an entry in the inspection record

words.enDefinition: A finding obtained by examining an item against specified inspection criteria.

examples.en: The inspection result identified a visible tear on the edge of the first classroom model.
examples.zh: 「检验结果」指出第一个课堂模型边缘有一处可见的撕裂。

examples.en: We discussed the second inspection result after locating the matching observation in our practice table.
examples.zh: 在练习表中找到对应的观察结果后，我们讨论了第二项「检验结果」。

words.enDefinition: A failure to meet a specified requirement.

examples.en: The teacher identified a nonconformity when the paper model lacked one feature required by the exercise.
examples.zh: 纸模型少了一项练习要求的特征，老师将其识别为一处「不符合项」。

examples.en: We described the nonconformity in the practice form by naming the feature and the relevant requirement.
examples.zh: 我们在练习表中写明特征及对应要求，以描述这一「不符合项」。

words.enDefinition: A measured indication outside the stated permitted limits for the feature being checked.

examples.en: The classroom data included one out-of-tolerance reading, which we marked next to the stated limits.
examples.zh: 课堂数据中有一个「超公差读数」，我们把它标在给定的极限值旁边。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to interpret the out-of-tolerance reading alongside the stated uncertainty in the example.
examples.zh: 辅导老师要求我们结合示例给出的不确定度解读这一「超公差读数」。

collocations: an out-of-tolerance reading in a table

words.enDefinition: The difference between a feature's measured size and a specified reference size.

examples.en: The dimensional deviation was positive because the measured length was greater than the nominal dimension.
examples.zh: 由于实测长度大于公称尺寸，「尺寸偏差」为正。

examples.en: We reported the dimensional deviation beside the original value in our classroom measurement table.
examples.zh: 在课堂测量表中，我们将「尺寸偏差」列在原始值旁边。

words.enDefinition: A conclusion about whether specified requirements are met under a stated decision rule.

examples.en: The exercise showed how uncertainty could affect a conformance decision when the result was near a limit.
examples.zh: 练习表明，结果接近极限值时，不确定度可能影响「符合性判定」。

examples.en: We recorded the conformance decision alongside the reason given in the instructor's hypothetical example.
examples.zh: 我们记录了辅导老师假设例题中的「符合性判定」及其理由。

collocations: a decision rule for a conformance decision

words.enDefinition: A chronological record of measurements, often including times, units, and sample identifiers.

examples.en: The measurement log let us match each classroom reading to the student and sample listed beside it.
examples.zh: 通过「测量日志」，我们能将课堂读数与旁边列出的学生和样品一一对应。

examples.en: We found the first reading in the measurement log before comparing results from the two sessions.
examples.zh: 比较两次实验课的结果之前，我们先在「测量日志」中找到了首个读数。

words.enDefinition: A notebook recording an investigation's setup, observations, decisions and data as the work proceeds.

examples.en: I sketched the cardboard setup in my lab notebook before recording results from the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我先在「实验记录本」里画出纸板装置，再记录课堂实验结果。

examples.en: The lab notebook showed when we switched to a second sample during the comparison.
examples.zh: 「实验记录本」显示了我们在比较中何时换用了第二件试样。

collocations: record data in a lab notebook

words.enDefinition: A drawing showing the arrangement and relative positions of parts used in a test.

examples.en: The test setup diagram showed where the classroom model sat in relation to the camera.
examples.zh: 「试验装置示意图」显示了课堂模型与相机的相对位置。

examples.en: We matched the photograph with the test setup diagram to locate the reference ruler in class.
examples.zh: 我们把照片与「试验装置示意图」对照，在课堂上找出参考尺的位置。

collocations: a component in the test setup diagram

words.enDefinition: A directly recorded measured value before correction, conversion, or averaging.

examples.en: We retained each raw measurement in the table before computing the average length of the classroom sample.
examples.zh: 计算课堂样品的平均长度之前，我们在表中保留了每个「原始测量值」。

examples.en: The report identified the raw measurement used to produce each value in the summary column.
examples.zh: 报告指明了汇总列中的每个数值是由哪个「原始测量值」所得。

collocations: compare a raw measurement with a corrected value

words.enDefinition: A separately obtained reading of the same quantity under stated measurement conditions.

examples.en: We took a replicate reading of the same marked slot without copying the value already in the table.
examples.zh: 我们对同一标记槽重新测量，得到一项「重复测量读数」。

examples.en: The next replicate reading went in a separate column so we could compare it with the first.
examples.zh: 下一项「重复测量读数」填入另一列，方便和第一次比较。

words.enDefinition: A separate specimen prepared under matching conditions to repeat a test comparison.

examples.en: The tutor supplied a replicate specimen from the same batch for the second classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 辅导老师从同一批次中提供了一件「平行试件」，用于第二次课堂比较。

examples.en: We labeled each replicate specimen separately even though all three came from one prepared sheet.
examples.zh: 三件试样虽取自同一张制备好的板材，我们仍分别标记了每件「平行试件」。

words.enDefinition: An initial or reference reading used to assess changes in later observations.

examples.en: We took the baseline reading before placing the first paper sample in the classroom setup.
examples.zh: 我们在把第一件纸样放进课堂装置前，先记录了「基线读数」。

examples.en: The graph used the baseline reading as the reference for the later changes in the model.
examples.zh: 图表以「基线读数」作为模型后续变化的参考。

collocations: compare readings with a baseline reading
a baseline reading before a test

words.enDefinition: A specimen kept under reference conditions or left untreated for comparison with tested specimens.

examples.en: The control specimen came from the same paper stock but did not receive the classroom treatment.
examples.zh: 「对照试件」取自相同纸料，但没有接受课堂实验所采用的处理。

examples.en: We placed the control specimen beside the treated piece when taking photographs for the report.
examples.zh: 为报告拍照时，我们把「对照试件」放在经过处理的样件旁边。

collocations: compare results with a control specimen

words.enDefinition: Loss of a material's ability to serve its intended function because of damage or deformation.

examples.en: The classroom example showed material failure when a paper tab tore and could no longer hold its shape.
examples.zh: 纸板凸舌撕裂、无法保持形状时，课堂例题将其记为「材料失效」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the visible bend counted as material failure for this particular model.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，就这个模型而言，可见的弯折是否算作「材料失效」。

words.enDefinition: The particular way an item stops performing an intended function.

examples.en: Tearing at the slot was the failure mode recorded for the first cardboard model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，第一个纸板模型记录的「失效模式」是在槽口处撕裂。

examples.en: Our worksheet assigned a different failure mode to the sample that separated along its glued seam.
examples.zh: 习题把沿胶合接缝分离的试样归为另一种「失效模式」。

words.enDefinition: The physical or chemical process that leads to a particular failure.

examples.en: The tutor proposed a failure mechanism involving repeated folding of the same narrow band of paper.
examples.zh: 辅导老师提出一种「失效机理」，与同一狭窄纸带反复折叠有关。

examples.en: We compared photographs to examine whether both torn samples shared the same failure mechanism in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们比较照片，研究练习中两个撕裂试样是否具有相同的「失效机理」。

words.enDefinition: A newly exposed surface created when a material cracks or breaks.

examples.en: We compared one fracture surface from each chalk sample under the same light in the photograph.
examples.zh: 我们在照片中比较了相同光照下两件课堂粉笔试样的「断口表面」。

examples.en: The instructor marked a pale region on the fracture surface in the close-up image of the sample.
examples.zh: 老师在试样近景图的「断口表面」上标出一块颜色较浅的区域。

collocations: a photo of a fracture surface

words.enDefinition: The formation of a new crack in a material.

examples.en: The first faint mark near the fold showed crack initiation in the sequence of classroom photographs.
examples.zh: 课堂系列照片中，折痕旁最早出现的一道浅痕显示了「裂纹萌生」。

examples.en: We used the earlier pictures to discuss where crack initiation might have occurred on the chalk sample.
examples.zh: 我们根据较早的照片讨论粉笔试样上可能发生「裂纹萌生」的位置。

words.enDefinition: Growth of an existing crack through a material.

examples.en: The time sequence showed crack propagation from one edge of the paper sample toward its center.
examples.zh: 连续图像显示，纸试样中的「裂纹扩展」从一侧边缘向中心发展。

examples.en: We marked the direction of crack propagation on the diagram rather than recording only the final break.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图上标出了「裂纹扩展」的方向，也记录了最终断裂。

words.enDefinition: An investigation of evidence to determine how and why a component failed.

examples.en: Our failure analysis compared images of the paper model before and after its tab tore.
examples.zh: 我们在「失效分析」中比较了纸模型凸舌撕裂前后的图片。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to separate observations from explanations in our short failure analysis of the model.
examples.zh: 辅导老师要求我们在模型的简短「失效分析」中，把观察结果与解释分开。

words.enDefinition: A stated condition used to identify when a specimen, material, or model has failed.

examples.en: A torn paper tab was the failure criterion in the classroom model comparison described in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 习题所述的课堂模型比较中，纸凸舌撕裂就是「失效判据」。

examples.en: We read the failure criterion on the classroom worksheet before comparing the photographs of the two samples.
examples.zh: 比较两个试样的照片前，我们先读了课堂习题上的「失效判据」。

collocations: apply a failure criterion in an exercise

words.enDefinition: An unexpected observation or event arising during a test and requiring interpretation.

examples.en: We flagged a test anomaly when one classroom reading appeared out of sequence in the simulated data.
examples.zh: 模拟数据里有一个课堂读数的顺序不对，我们将其标为一项「试验异常」。

examples.en: The report described the test anomaly before explaining why its cause remained uncertain in the exercise.
examples.zh: 报告先说明了「试验异常」，然后解释练习中为何仍无法确定其原因。

collocations: a note about a test anomaly

words.enDefinition: A restriction on what a measurement can represent, distinguish, or establish.

examples.en: The measurement limitation arose because the camera could only show the front of the classroom model.
examples.zh: 相机只能拍到课堂模型的正面，带来了「测量局限」。

examples.en: We explained a measurement limitation after noticing that two close lengths produced the same displayed value.
examples.zh: 发现两个相近的长度显示为同一数值后，我们说明了这项「测量局限」。

collocations: a measurement limitation in the report
